examTags: 语法·助动词后的动词原形
grammar: v. 意思是；打算。mean—meant—meant。What does ... mean? 用于询问词义；mean to do 表示“打算做”。
collocations: What does ... mean?; mean a lot; mean to do sth.。
commonMistake: does 后接动词原形：What does it mean? 不说 What does it means?

example.english: What does “together” mean?
example.chinese: “together”是什么意思？

application.prompt: What does the word “hike” ___? A. mean B. means
application.solution: A。解析：does 后接动词原形 mean。

grammar: n. 丈夫；可数，复数 husbands。通常与 wife（妻子）对应。
collocations: her husband; husband and wife; a loving husband。
commonMistake: husband 是可数名词，单数前通常需要限定词，如 her husband 或 a husband。

example.english: My aunt and her husband live near us.
example.chinese: 我姑姑和她丈夫住在我们附近。

application.prompt: A woman is married to Dan. Dan is her ___. A. husband B. sister
application.solution: A。解析：女性的男性配偶是 husband（丈夫）。

examTags: 阅读·根据用途识别物品
grammar: n. 球棒；可数，复数 bats。也可指蝙蝠，需结合语境判断；棒球球棒可说 baseball bat。
collocations: a baseball bat; hit the ball with a bat; a bat and a ball。
commonMistake: bat 既可指球棒，也可指蝙蝠；看上下文中的 ball、game 或 fly、animal 等词来判断。

example.english: He uses a bat to hit the ball.
example.chinese: 他用球棒击球。

application.prompt: In a baseball game, a player hits the ball with a ___. A. bat B. violin
application.solution: A。解析：棒球运动员用 bat（球棒）击球。

examTags: 阅读·理解人物共同活动
grammar: adv. 在一起；共同。常与动词连用，如 live/work/play together；也可用 together with 表示“和……一起”。
collocations: play together; work together; live together; together with。
commonMistake: together 是副词，不说 togetherly；常放在动词或宾语之后，如 play tennis together。

example.english: The whole family eats dinner together on Sunday.
example.chinese: 全家人周日一起吃晚饭。

application.prompt: Mia and her brother do their homework at the same time. They study ___. A. together B. alone
application.solution: A。解析：两个人一起学习用 together；alone 表示独自。

grammar: v. 花费（时间或钱）。spend—spent—spent。常用 spend time/money on sth. 或 spend time/money (in) doing sth.。
collocations: spend time with family; spend money on books; spend an hour reading。
commonMistake: 表示“花时间做某事”用 spend time doing，不说 spend time to do；过去式为 spent。

example.english: I spend an hour reading with my sister every evening.
example.chinese: 我每天晚上花一个小时和妹妹一起读书。

application.prompt: We spend Saturday afternoon ___ chess. A. playing B. to play
application.solution: A。解析：spend time doing sth. 表示“花时间做某事”。

examTags: 词汇·副词修饰与语境义
grammar: adv. 非常；确实；真正地。可放在形容词前表示程度，也可放在实义动词前表示“确实”。
collocations: really funny; really like; really good; Really?。
commonMistake: really 是副词，常修饰形容词或动词；real 是形容词，如 a real friend。

example.english: My little brother is really funny.
example.chinese: 我弟弟真的很有趣。

application.prompt: I ___ enjoy playing chess with my grandpa. A. really B. real
application.solution: A。解析：此处修饰动词 enjoy，要用副词 really。

examTags: 词汇·可数名词与单复数
grammar: n. 成员；会员。可数，复数 members。表示所属常用 a member of ...。
collocations: a family member; a member of the chess club; club members。
commonMistake: 常说 a member of the family/club；member 是可数名词，单数前需要限定词。

example.english: My sister is a member of the school music club.
example.chinese: 我姐姐是学校音乐社团的一名成员。

application.prompt: Ben joined the chess club. He is now a ___ of the club. A. member B. knee
application.solution: A。解析：加入社团的人是该社团的 member（成员）。

grammar: n. 活动；可数，复数 activities：辅音字母 + y 结尾时，变 y 为 i 再加 -es。
collocations: family activities; outdoor activities; after-school activity。
commonMistake: activity 的复数是 activities，不是 activitys；many 后用 activities。

example.english: Our family enjoys outdoor activities in summer.
example.chinese: 我们一家喜欢在夏天参加户外活动。

application.prompt: The school has many fun ___. A. activity B. activities
application.solution: B。解析：many 后接可数名词复数，activity 变为 activities。

grammar: n. 国际象棋；通常作不可数名词，表示下棋时说 play chess，不加 a 或 the。
collocations: play chess; a chess game; a chess player。
commonMistake: 表示下国际象棋用 play chess，不说 play a chess；chess 通常不加复数 -es。

example.english: My grandpa teaches me to play chess.
example.chinese: 爷爷教我下国际象棋。

application.prompt: On rainy days, we play ___ at home. A. chess B. a chess
application.solution: A。解析：chess 作棋类活动名称时通常不加冠词。

examTags: 阅读·理解人物或事件特点
grammar: adj. 好笑的；有趣的；也可表示奇怪的。比较级 funnier，最高级 funniest。
collocations: a funny story; a funny face; sound funny。
commonMistake: funny 常表示“令人发笑的”，fun 常表示“有趣的、令人愉快的”；描述名词用 funny story。

example.english: Uncle Ben tells funny stories at dinner.
example.chinese: Ben 叔叔晚饭时讲好笑的故事。

application.prompt: Everyone laughs at the joke. The joke is ___. A. funny B. quiet
application.solution: A。解析：能让大家发笑的笑话是 funny（好笑的）。

grammar: v. 笑；n. 笑声。作动词时 laugh—laughed—laughed；laugh at sb./sth. 表示“因……而笑”。
collocations: laugh at a joke; laugh with a friend; a loud laugh。
commonMistake: 表示“嘲笑某人”或“因某事发笑”常用 laugh at；区别 smile（微笑），laugh 通常有笑声。

example.english: We all laugh when Grandpa tells that story.
example.chinese: 爷爷讲那个故事时，我们都笑了。

application.prompt: The joke is so funny that we all ___. A. laugh B. laugh at
application.solution: A。解析：句子中 laugh 后没有宾语；laugh at 后通常要接笑的对象或事情。

examTags: 词汇·形容词与介词搭配
grammar: adj. 不同的。常用 be different from；different 后可接名词，如 different hobbies。
collocations: be different from; different people; many different activities。
commonMistake: 常见搭配是 different from；different 是形容词，be 后可作表语。

example.english: My brother and I have different hobbies.
example.chinese: 我和哥哥有不同的爱好。

application.prompt: Our two bags are not the same colour. They are ___. A. different B. together
application.solution: A。解析：颜色不相同，说明这两个包是 different（不同的）。

examTags: 语言运用·音乐爱好表达
grammar: n. 小提琴；可数，复数 violins。表示演奏乐器时常说 play the violin。
collocations: play the violin; a violin lesson; a violin player。
commonMistake: 表示演奏小提琴常说 play the violin；表示“一个小提琴”则用 a violin。

example.english: Her daughter plays the violin in the school band.
example.chinese: 她的女儿在学校乐队里拉小提琴。

application.prompt: Nora has music lessons and practises ___ violin. A. the B. an
application.solution: A。解析：表示演奏乐器时通常用 play/practise the violin。

examTags: 阅读·根据颜色识别物品
grammar: adj. 粉红色的；n. 粉红色。作形容词修饰名词时不随名词变复数。
collocations: a pink hat; pink flowers; the colour pink。
commonMistake: 作颜色形容词时不加复数 -s：pink hats；也可用 in pink 描述穿粉色衣服。

example.english: My sister wears a pink hat in spring.
example.chinese: 我妹妹春天戴一顶粉色帽子。

application.prompt: The flower is not red or white; it is ___. A. pink B. chess
application.solution: A。解析：pink 是一种颜色，表示粉红色。

examTags: 词汇·可数名词与单复数
grammar: n. 帽子；可数，复数 hats。单数前需有限定词，如 a hat、my hat。
collocations: wear a hat; take off your hat; a sun hat。
commonMistake: hat 是可数名词，单数前不能漏掉 a/the/物主限定词；复数是 hats。

example.english: Please take off your hat when you come inside.
example.chinese: 请进屋时摘下帽子。

application.prompt: It is sunny. Dad puts ___ on his head. A. a hat B. a knee
application.solution: A。解析：晴天戴在头上的物品是帽子 hat。

grammar: adj. 英俊的；通常用于描述男性，也可形容外观漂亮、气派的事物。初中写作比较级、最高级可用 more handsome / most handsome。
collocations: a handsome man; a handsome young son; a handsome building。
commonMistake: handsome 是形容词，常用来描述男性外貌；作表语时说 He is handsome。

example.english: My grandma says my father was a handsome young man.
example.chinese: 奶奶说我爸爸年轻时是个英俊的小伙子。

application.prompt: The family photo shows a good-looking young man. He is ___. A. handsome B. noisy
application.solution: A。解析：handsome 常用来形容英俊的男性。

grammar: n. 膝盖；可数，复数 knees。单词开头的 k 不发音，读音以 /n/ 开始。
collocations: bend your knees; hurt your knee; on your knees。
commonMistake: knee 开头的 k 不发音；拼写时保留 k，复数加 -s：knees。

example.english: He fell and hurt his knee during the hike.
example.chinese: 徒步时他摔倒并伤到了膝盖。

application.prompt: You bend this part of your leg when you sit. It is your ___. A. knee B. hat
application.solution: A。解析：腿部坐下时弯曲的关节是 knee（膝盖）。

examTags: 词汇·家庭关系与不规则复数
grammar: n. 孙辈；可数。复数 grandchild 的拼写变为 grandchildren，和 child—children 一样是不规则变化。
collocations: a grandchild; grandchildren; a grandchild of theirs。
commonMistake: 复数是 grandchildren，不是 grandchilds；grandchild 可指孙子或孙女。

example.english: Their first grandchild is a little boy.
example.chinese: 他们的第一个孙辈是个小男孩。

application.prompt: Ella is the daughter of my son. Ella is my ___. A. grandchild B. husband
application.solution: A。解析：儿子或女儿的孩子是自己的 grandchild（孙辈）。

examTags: 词汇·家庭成员与名词复数
grammar: n. 儿子；可数，复数 sons。可用 one's son、a son of mine 等表达所属关系。
collocations: their son; a son and a daughter; an only son。
commonMistake: son 的复数是 sons；不要与 sun（太阳）混淆，两个词发音相同但拼写和意思不同。

example.english: Their son helps his mother in the garden.
example.chinese: 他们的儿子在花园里帮助妈妈。

application.prompt: Mr and Mrs Lee have one boy. He is their ___. A. son B. mother
application.solution: A。解析：父母的男孩孩子是 son（儿子）。

examTags: 语言运用·休闲活动表达
grammar: v. 徒步旅行；n. 徒步旅行。作动词时 hike—hiked—hiked—hiking；常用 go hiking 或 go for a hike。
collocations: go hiking; go for a hike; hike in the hills。
commonMistake: 表示“去徒步”常说 go hiking；也可说 hike in the mountains，hike 可作动词直接使用。

example.english: We go hiking with our cousins in autumn.
example.chinese: 秋天我们和表兄妹一起去徒步。

application.prompt: Every Sunday, we ___ in the hills near our town. A. hike B. hikes
application.solution: A。解析：主语 we 是复数，一般现在时用动词原形 hike。

examTags: 语言运用·选择与否定表达
grammar: conj. 或者；用于连接选择项。在否定句中可连接并列成分，表示“也不/也没有”。
collocations: tea or coffee; two or three; not ... or ...。
commonMistake: 选择疑问常用 A or B；否定句中可说 I don't have a brother or a sister，表示两者都没有。

example.english: Would you like to hike or play chess this weekend?
example.chinese: 这个周末你想去徒步还是下国际象棋？

application.prompt: Would you like tea ___ milk? Choose one drink. A. or B. because
application.solution: A。解析：提出两种选择时用 or（或者）。

grammar: n. 母亲；可数，复数 mothers。称呼家人时也可用 Mum（英式）或 Mom（美式）。
collocations: my mother; mother and child; a mother of two。
commonMistake: mother 是可数名词；说“我的母亲”用 my mother，不在 my 前再加 a。

example.english: My mother teaches me how to cook.
example.chinese: 妈妈教我做饭。

application.prompt: My father's wife is my ___. A. mother B. sister
application.solution: A。解析：父亲的妻子通常是自己的 mother（母亲）。

grammar: n. 儿童；小孩。单数 child，复数 children，是不规则变化。
collocations: a small child; children at school; a child of six。
commonMistake: child 的复数是 children，不是 childs；many 后用 children。

example.english: The children are playing with their grandmother.
example.chinese: 孩子们正在和奶奶一起玩。

application.prompt: There are three ___ in the family photo. A. children B. childs
application.solution: A。解析：child 的不规则复数是 children。

examTags: 词汇·家庭成员与名词复数
grammar: n. 姐妹；姐姐或妹妹。可数，复数 sisters；需要区分年龄时可说 older sister 或 younger sister。
collocations: my sister; an older sister; sisters and brothers。
commonMistake: sister 本身不说明年长或年幼；要表达姐姐/妹妹，可分别用 older sister/younger sister。

example.english: My younger sister is learning to play the violin.
example.chinese: 我妹妹正在学拉小提琴。

application.prompt: Lily and I have the same parents. Lily is my ___. A. sister B. son
application.solution: A。解析：有共同父母的女孩兄弟姐妹是 sister（姐妹）。

grammar: 可数名词，表示兄或弟；复数为 brothers。表示年龄较大的兄弟可说 older brother。
collocations: older brother；younger brother；brothers and sisters
commonMistake: brother 可表示兄或弟，不单独说明年龄；需要区分时加 older 或 younger。

example.english: My brother Ben is two years older than me.
example.chinese: 我哥哥本比我大两岁。

application.prompt: Tom and Ben are boys in the same family. Ben is Tom's ___.
application.solution: brother

grammar: 可数名词，表示堂/表兄弟姐妹，不区分性别；复数为 cousins。
collocations: my cousin；a cousin of mine；cousins from Canada
commonMistake: cousin 本身不说明性别；不要根据 cousin 一词推断是男孩还是女孩。

example.english: My cousin Eva is in Grade 7, too.
example.chinese: 我的表姐伊娃也上七年级。

application.prompt: My aunt's son is my ___.
application.solution: cousin

grammar: 可数名词，表示姑、姨、伯母、婶婶或舅母；复数为 aunts。
collocations: Aunt May；my aunt and uncle；aunt's family
commonMistake: aunt 可指父母的姐妹，也可指叔伯舅姨的妻子；具体关系需看上下文。

example.english: My aunt May brings fruit when she visits us.
example.chinese: 梅姨来探望我们时会带水果。

application.prompt: My mother's sister is my ___.
application.solution: aunt

grammar: 可数名词，表示祖母或外祖母；复数为 grandmothers；口语中也常说 grandma。
collocations: my grandmother；maternal grandmother；visit your grandmother
commonMistake: grandmother 可指父亲的母亲或母亲的母亲；需要区分时可补充 paternal/maternal。

example.english: My grandmother tells us stories after dinner.
example.chinese: 晚饭后，我的奶奶/外婆给我们讲故事。

application.prompt: My mother's mother is my ___.
application.solution: grandmother

grammar: 不规则动词，come—came—come；第三人称单数为 comes。常用 come to a place、come from；come home 中 home 前通常不加 to。
collocations: come to school；come home；come from；come and see
commonMistake: come 的过去式是 came；表示“回家/来家里”时可说 come home，不说 come to home。

example.english: Please come to our classroom after lunch.
example.chinese: 请在午饭后到我们教室来。

application.prompt: Mia will ___ to our house after school. (come)
application.solution: come

grammar: 名词，表示乒乓球运动，通常作不可数名词；也称 table tennis。
collocations: play ping-pong；a ping-pong table；a ping-pong game
commonMistake: 表示进行这项运动常用 play ping-pong，不在运动名称前加 a。

example.english: We play ping-pong in the school gym on Fridays.
example.chinese: 我们每周五在学校体育馆打乒乓球。

application.prompt: The table sport played with small bats and a light ball is called ___.
application.solution: ping-pong

examTags: 语法·疑问限定词与代词
grammar: 疑问词，询问“谁的”；可放在名词前，如 Whose bag...?，也可单独使用，如 Whose is this?。
collocations: whose book；whose turn；Whose is this?
commonMistake: whose 表示“谁的”；who's 是 who is 或 who has 的缩写，两者读音相同但用法不同。

example.english: Whose backpack is beside the classroom door?
example.chinese: 教室门旁边的背包是谁的？

application.prompt: Ask about ownership: ___ notebook is this?
application.solution: Whose

grammar: 可作副词，表示“好地”；作形容词时常表示“健康的”；也可作感叹词或话语标记，表示“嗯/好吧”。
collocations: play well；do well；be well；Well, let's begin.
commonMistake: 修饰动作时常用副词 well，如 read well；good 通常是形容词。

example.english: Well, let's read the family story together.
example.chinese: 嗯，我们一起读这个家庭故事吧。

application.prompt: After practising every day, Leo plays the piano ___. (well / good)
application.solution: well

examTags: 语法·限定词与主谓一致
grammar: 限定词，表示“每一个”，后接单数可数名词；作主语中心词时，谓语动词通常用单数。
collocations: every day；every week；every student；every member
commonMistake: every 后接单数名词，如 every student；不能说 every students。

example.english: Every student brings a book to class.
example.chinese: 每位学生都带一本书来上课。

application.prompt: ___ member of the family has a place at the table. (Every / All)
application.solution: Every

grammar: 可数名词，表示一天或白天；复数为 days。every day 是“每天”，everyday 作形容词时表示“日常的”。
collocations: every day；all day；day and night；a school day
commonMistake: every day 是“每天”的时间短语；everyday 是形容词，如 everyday life。

example.english: We read together for ten minutes every day.
example.chinese: 我们每天一起阅读十分钟。

application.prompt: A week has seven ___. (day)
application.solution: days

grammar: 可数名词，表示周；复数为 weeks。一周通常有七天。
collocations: this week；next week；last week；once a week
commonMistake: 表示“每周一次”说 once a week；表示多周时 week 要用复数 weeks。

example.english: Our family has dinner together once a week.
example.chinese: 我们一家每周一起吃一次晚饭。

application.prompt: There are seven days in a ___.
application.solution: week

grammar: 可作动词，表示钓鱼，第三人称单数为 fishes；也可作名词表示鱼或鱼肉，复数常为 fish，表示不同种类时也可用 fishes。
collocations: fish in a lake；go fishing；catch fish；fresh fish
commonMistake: fish 作动词时 he/she/it 后用 fishes；作动物名词时复数常仍是 fish。

example.english: We fish by the lake on warm weekends.
example.chinese: 天气暖和的周末，我们会在湖边钓鱼。

application.prompt: My grandfather ___ by the river every Sunday. (fish)
application.solution: fishes

grammar: 可数名词，表示父亲；复数为 fathers。称呼自己的父亲时也常说 Dad。
collocations: my father；father and mother；father's name
commonMistake: father 是名词；表示“我的父亲”用 my father，不在 my 后再加 a。

example.english: My father reads the news after breakfast.
example.chinese: 我爸爸早饭后读新闻。

application.prompt: My mother's husband is my ___.
application.solution: father

grammar: 可数名词，表示钢琴；复数为 pianos。谈演奏乐器时，play 后通常加 the。
collocations: play the piano；a piano lesson；piano music
commonMistake: 表示“弹钢琴”常说 play the piano；乐器前通常保留 the。

example.english: My sister practises the piano after school.
example.chinese: 我姐姐放学后练钢琴。

application.prompt: Sara plays an instrument with black and white keys. She is learning the ___.
application.solution: piano

grammar: 可作不可数名词，表示篮球运动；也可作可数名词，表示篮球。
collocations: play basketball；a basketball game；a basketball team
commonMistake: 表示做篮球运动时说 play basketball，通常不说 play a basketball。

example.english: Our class plays basketball after school on Tuesdays.
example.chinese: 我们班每周二放学后打篮球。

application.prompt: In this sport, players try to throw a ball through a high hoop. They play ___.
application.solution: basketball

grammar: 动词，表示读或阅读；现在式 read /riːd/，过去式和过去分词拼写仍为 read，但读音为 /red/；第三人称单数为 reads。
collocations: read a book；read a story；read about animals
commonMistake: read 的现在式与过去式拼写相同，但过去式读作 /red/；需结合句中时间判断。

example.english: I read a short story with my brother every night.
example.chinese: 我每天晚上和哥哥/弟弟读一个短故事。

application.prompt: Tom ___ a story to his little sister every night. (read)
application.solution: reads

grammar: 可作可数名词，表示种花或种菜的园子；也可作动词，表示做园艺。动词形式为 garden—gardened—gardened。
collocations: in the garden；a flower garden；garden together；garden tools
commonMistake: garden 作名词指园子，作动词表示照料园子、做园艺；gardened 是其过去式。

example.english: There are roses and tomatoes in my grandmother's garden.
example.chinese: 我奶奶/外婆的园子里有玫瑰和西红柿。

application.prompt: Every weekend, my grandparents ___ in the back garden. (garden)
application.solution: garden

grammar: 可数名词，由 class + room 构成，表示教室；复数为 classrooms。
collocations: in the classroom；classroom door；classroom rules
commonMistake: classroom 是“教室”，class 是“班级/课”；不要把两个词的意思混为一谈。

example.english: Our classroom has a large window and a reading corner.
example.chinese: 我们的教室有一扇大窗户和一个阅读角。

application.prompt: We learn with our teacher and classmates in the ___.
application.solution: classroom

grammar: 形容词性物主代词/物主限定词，表示“他们/她们/它们的”，后接名词；单独使用时用 theirs。
collocations: their family；their classroom；their books
commonMistake: their 后接名词；there 表示“那里”，they're 是 they are 的缩写。

example.english: The twins keep their books on one shelf.
example.chinese: 这对双胞胎把他们的书放在同一个书架上。

application.prompt: Sam and Ella have two cats. ___ cats are both grey. (Their / Theirs)
application.solution: Their

sources.label: Cambridge Grammar: possessive determiners and pronouns

examTags: 语言运用·校园与家庭任务
grammar: 可作形容词，表示干净的；也可作动词，表示打扫或清洁。动词过去式和过去分词为 cleaned。
collocations: clean the room；keep clean；clean clothes；clean up
commonMistake: clean 可作动词也可作形容词；如 clean the desk 是“打扫桌子”，a clean desk 是“干净的桌子”。

example.english: Please clean the table after lunch.
example.chinese: 请在午饭后把桌子擦干净。

application.prompt: Let's ___ the classroom after art class. (clean)
application.solution: clean

examTags: 语言运用·描述大小与年龄
grammar: 形容词，可表示小的或年幼的；可放在名词前作定语，也可作表语。
collocations: a little cat；a little brother；a little girl
commonMistake: little 可描述体积小或年龄小；表示数量少时 a little 还可修饰不可数名词，需看语境。

example.english: The little puppy follows its mother around the garden.
example.chinese: 那只小狗跟着妈妈在园子里转。

application.prompt: The kitten is very small. It is a ___ cat. (little / big)
application.solution: little

grammar: 可数名词，表示球；复数为 balls。
collocations: a basketball；a ball game；kick/throw a ball
commonMistake: ball 是“球”这一物品；basketball 还可表示篮球运动。

example.english: The red ball rolls across the playground.
example.chinese: 红球滚过了操场。

application.prompt: A round object used in basketball is a ___.
application.solution: ball

grammar: 可数名词，由 play + ground 构成，指供儿童玩耍或学生活动的场地；复数为 playgrounds。
collocations: school playground；on the playground；playground equipment
commonMistake: playground 指操场或游乐场等活动场地；playground 不等同于 classroom。

example.english: The children play ball games on the playground at break time.
example.chinese: 课间时，孩子们在操场上玩球类游戏。

application.prompt: Students run and play outside during break in the school ___.
application.solution: playground

grammar: 动词，表示穿着或戴着；不规则变化为 wear—wore—worn，第三人称单数为 wears。
collocations: wear a coat；wear glasses；wear a uniform
commonMistake: wear 表示穿戴的状态；put on 表示穿上、戴上的动作。

example.english: My father wears a blue shirt to work.
example.chinese: 我爸爸上班时穿一件蓝色衬衫。

application.prompt: My brother ___ a warm coat to school every winter. (wear)
application.solution: wears

grammar: talk 可作动词“说话、交谈”，也可作名词“谈话”。作动词时常用 talk to/with sb、talk about sth；名词常见 have a talk。
collocations: talk to/with a friend; talk about family; have a talk with sb
commonMistake: 表示“和某人交谈”通常说 talk to/with sb；表示谈论某事说 talk about sth，不要漏掉相应介词。

example.english: I often talk with my sister about our school day.
example.chinese: 我常和姐姐谈论我们在学校的一天。

application.prompt: 选词填空：We talk ___ our grandparents on the phone every Sunday. A. to  B. at
application.solution: A. to。talk to sb 表示“和某人交谈”。

grammar: tall 是形容词，表示人或物“高的”；比较级 taller，最高级 tallest。询问身高常用 How tall...?。
collocations: a tall boy; a tall tree; be 1.6 metres tall; taller than
commonMistake: 描述人的身高通常用 tall；描述离地面高的位置或高度时常用 high。

example.english: My cousin is taller than me now.
example.chinese: 我表哥现在比我高。

application.prompt: 选词填空：Ben is 1.75 metres ___. A. tall  B. long
application.solution: A. tall。描述人的身高用 tall。

grammar: short 是形容词，可表示长度“短的”、身高“矮的”或时间“短暂的”；比较级 shorter，最高级 shortest。
collocations: short hair; a short story; a short boy; be short for
commonMistake: short 修饰人的身高时是“矮的”，修饰物品或时间时通常是“短的”；不要和表示“短暂地”的副词 briefly 混淆。

example.english: Mia has short hair and a bright smile.
example.chinese: 米娅留着短发，笑容灿烂。

application.prompt: 选词填空：The opposite of “long” in “a long story” is ___. A. short  B. tall
application.solution: A. short。谈故事长度时，long 的反义词是 short。

examTags: 词法·可数与不可数名词
grammar: hair 表示头发的整体时通常作不可数名词；指一根头发时可数，复数为 hairs。描述头发常用形容词 + hair。
collocations: long/short hair; black hair; brush your hair; a grey hair
commonMistake: 泛指一个人的头发时说 She has long hair，不加 -s；只有强调一根或几根头发时才用 a hair/hairs。

example.english: My dad has short black hair.
example.chinese: 我爸爸留着黑色短发。

application.prompt: 选词填空：Lily has long ___. A. hair  B. hairs
application.solution: A. hair。此处泛指头发整体，hair 通常作不可数名词。

grammar: long 是形容词，表示长度或时间“长的”；How long...? 可询问长度或持续时间。
collocations: long hair; a long story; a long time; How long is...?
commonMistake: 询问长度或持续时间用 How long；long 描述物体的长度，描述人或建筑的高度通常用 tall。

example.english: How long is the table in your dining room?
example.chinese: 你家餐厅的桌子有多长？

application.prompt: 选词填空：The river is 20 kilometres ___. A. long  B. tall
application.solution: A. long。河流的长度用 long 描述。

grammar: quiet 是形容词，表示“安静的”；可作定语，也可放在 be、feel 等系动词后作表语。
collocations: be quiet; keep quiet; a quiet room; a quiet voice
commonMistake: quiet 是形容词，quite 是副词，拼写和含义不同；说“请安静”可用 Please be quiet.。

example.english: Our family is quiet during the reading time.
example.chinese: 阅读时间我们家很安静。

application.prompt: 选词填空：Please be ___ while your sister is reading. A. quiet  B. quietly
application.solution: A. quiet。be 后接形容词作表语。

grammar: girl 是可数名词，表示“女孩”；复数为 girls，直接加 -s。
collocations: a little girl; two girls; a girl in my class
commonMistake: girl 是可数名词，单数前通常要有 a、the 或物主限定词；复数形式是 girls。

example.english: The girl in the family photo is my cousin.
example.chinese: 家庭照片里的女孩是我的表妹。

application.prompt: 选词填空：There are two ___ in the family picture. A. girl  B. girls
application.solution: B. girls。two 后接可数名词复数，girl 加 -s。

grammar: but 是并列连词，连接词、短语或分句，表示转折“但是”；连接分句时两边通常是对比或相反的信息。
collocations: small but strong; not this but that; ..., but ...
commonMistake: but 表示转折，不表示原因；because 已经引导原因时，不要再在同一个分句前加 so 表示结果。

example.english: My brother is quiet, but he is very funny at home.
example.chinese: 我哥哥很安静，但他在家里很有趣。

application.prompt: 选词填空：The story is short, ___ it is full of fun. A. but  B. because
application.solution: A. but。前后是“短”和“有趣”的转折关系，用 but。

grammar: any 可作限定词或代词；常在疑问句和否定句中表示“一些/任何”。在肯定句中也可表示“任一、任何一个”。
collocations: any photos; any questions; any of them; not ... any
commonMistake: any 本身不表示否定，常与 not 等否定词连用；否定句通常说 not ... any。

example.english: Do you have any photos of your grandparents?
example.chinese: 你有祖父母的照片吗？

application.prompt: 选词填空：I don't have ___ photos of that trip. A. any  B. a
application.solution: A. any。否定句中可用 any；photos 是复数，不能用 a。

grammar: photo 是可数名词，表示“照片”；复数为 photos，直接加 -s。
collocations: take a photo; family photo; a photo of my parents; look at photos
commonMistake: photo 的复数是 photos，不是 photoes；表示“某人的照片”可说 a photo of sb。

example.english: We take a family photo every New Year.
example.chinese: 我们每年新年都会拍一张全家福。

application.prompt: 选词填空：There are three ___ of our family on the wall. A. photo  B. photos
application.solution: B. photos。three 后接可数名词复数，photo 加 -s。

grammar: left 可作名词或副词表示“左边、向左”；常见表达有 on the left 和 turn left。
collocations: on the left; to the left of; turn left; left hand
commonMistake: 表示“在左边”常说 on the left；表示“向左转”说 turn left，不在 left 前加 to。

example.english: My grandfather sits on the left in this photo.
example.chinese: 这张照片里我爷爷坐在左边。

application.prompt: 选词填空：The library is on the ___ side of the road opposite the right side. A. left  B. right
application.solution: A. left。句中明确说与 right side 相对，因此是 left side。

grammar: right 可作形容词表示“正确的、右边的”，也可作名词或副词表示“右边、向右”；需结合上下文判断词义。
collocations: the right answer; the right hand; on the right; turn right
commonMistake: right 表示“正确的”时常作形容词，如 the right answer；表示方向时常用 on the right 或 turn right。

example.english: You are right: this is our family photo.
example.chinese: 你说得对：这就是我们的全家福。

application.prompt: 选词填空：You chose the correct answer, so your answer is ___. A. right  B. left
application.solution: A. right。题干说明答案正确，right 表示“正确的”。

grammar: always 是频度副词，表示“总是”；通常放在实义动词前、be 动词后，也可放在第一个助动词或情态动词后。
collocations: always help; always be kind; always remember; as always
commonMistake: 一般现在时中，always 通常放在实义动词前、be 动词后；主语是第三人称单数时，谓语仍需加 -s/-es。

example.english: Grandma always tells us a story before bed.
example.chinese: 奶奶睡前总会给我们讲一个故事。

application.prompt: 选择语序正确的句子：A. My brother always helps me.  B. My brother helps always me.
application.solution: A。always 通常放在实义动词 helps 前。

grammar: story 是可数名词，表示“故事”；复数为 stories，辅音字母 + y 结尾时变 y 为 i 再加 -es。
collocations: tell a story; read a story; a family story; short stories
commonMistake: story 的复数是 stories，不是 storys；辅音字母 + y 结尾的可数名词复数通常变 y 为 i 加 -es。

example.english: My aunt tells funny stories about her childhood.
example.chinese: 姑姑会讲一些她童年时的有趣故事。

application.prompt: 选词填空：Dad reads two short ___ to us every night. A. storys  B. stories
application.solution: B. stories。story 以辅音字母 + y 结尾，复数变 y 为 i 再加 -es。

grammar: night 是可数名词，也可作不可数用法；泛指夜间常用 at night，特指某一晚可说 at night 或 that night，需看语境。
collocations: at night; last night; every night; spend the night
commonMistake: 表示一般的“在夜间”常说 at night；last night 前不加 at。

example.english: Our family often looks at the stars at night.
example.chinese: 我们一家常在夜晚看星星。

application.prompt: 选词填空：The moon is easy to see ___ night. A. at  B. on
application.solution: A. at。表示一般的“在夜间”用固定表达 at night。

grammar: middle 可作名词“中间、中央”或形容词“中间的”；常用 in the middle of 表示“在……中间”。
collocations: in the middle; in the middle of the room; the middle child; the middle name
commonMistake: 表示“在……中间”常用 in the middle of；middle 作名词时常与 the 连用。

example.english: My mother is standing in the middle of the family photo.
example.chinese: 我妈妈站在全家福的中间。

application.prompt: 选词填空：The table is in the ___ of the room, with chairs around it. A. middle  B. corner
application.solution: A. middle。桌子四周都有椅子，说明桌子在房间中间。

grammar: think 是动词，过去式和过去分词均为 thought；可用 think about/of sth 表示“思考/想到某事”，也可接 that 从句表达看法。
collocations: think about a question; think of an idea; think that; think carefully
commonMistake: think 的过去式是 thought，不是 thinked；表示“考虑某事”常用 think about/of sth。

example.english: I think my sister is very clever.
example.chinese: 我觉得我妹妹很聪明。

application.prompt: 选词填空：Yesterday, I ___ about a good gift for Dad. A. thought  B. think
application.solution: A. thought。Yesterday 表示过去，think 的过去式是 thought。

grammar: football 表示“足球运动”时通常作不可数名词，play football 前不加冠词；表示球时是可数名词，可说 a football。
collocations: play football; a football team; a football match; football player
commonMistake: 表示进行足球运动时说 play football，不说 play the football；a football 可指一个足球。

example.english: My brother plays football with our cousins after school.
example.chinese: 我哥哥放学后和堂兄弟们踢足球。

application.prompt: 选词填空：We play ___ together in the park. A. football  B. the football
application.solution: A. football。football 表示球类运动时，play 后通常不加冠词。

examTags: 语法·系动词后接形容词
grammar: happy 是形容词，表示“快乐的”；常作表语，放在 be、feel 等系动词后，也可作定语修饰名词。比较级 happier，最高级 happiest。
collocations: be happy; feel happy; happy family; happy with/about
commonMistake: 系动词 be/feel 后用形容词 happy，不用副词 happily；happy 的比较级为 happier。

example.english: I feel happy when the whole family has dinner together.
example.chinese: 全家一起吃饭时，我感到很快乐。

application.prompt: 选词填空：The children feel ___ when Grandpa tells them stories. A. happy  B. happily
application.solution: A. happy。feel 在此是系动词，后接形容词作表语。

grammar: eye 是可数名词，表示“眼睛”；复数为 eyes，直接加 -s。
collocations: brown eyes; blue eyes; close your eyes; look someone in the eye
commonMistake: 表示两只眼睛时用复数 eyes；注意 eyes 的拼写是 eye + s。

example.english: My little brother has big brown eyes.
example.chinese: 我弟弟有一双大大的棕色眼睛。

application.prompt: 选词填空：The baby has two bright ___. A. eye  B. eyes
application.solution: B. eyes。two 后接名词复数，eye 的复数是 eyes。

examTags: 语法·形容词作表语与定语
grammar: clever 是形容词，表示“聪明的”；可作定语或放在 be 后作表语。常见搭配 clever at sth。
collocations: a clever child; be clever at maths; a clever idea; clever with your hands
commonMistake: clever 是形容词，修饰名词或作表语；cleverly 才是副词，表示“聪明地”。

example.english: My clever sister can remember everyone's birthday.
example.chinese: 我聪明的姐姐能记住每个人的生日。

application.prompt: 选词填空：Tom is ___ at solving number puzzles. A. clever  B. cleverly
application.solution: A. clever。be clever at 是“擅长/善于……”的表达，be 后用形容词。

grammar: next 可作形容词、副词或代词，表示“下一个、接下来”；next to 表示“紧挨着”。表示将来的 next week/day 前通常不加 on 或 the。
collocations: next week; next time; the next person; next to my dad
commonMistake: 表示“下周/明天”通常直接说 next week/tomorrow，不说 on next week 或 the next week（表示未来一周时）。

example.english: We are visiting our grandparents next Sunday.
example.chinese: 我们下周日去看望祖父母。

application.prompt: 选词填空：Our family picnic is ___ Sunday. A. next  B. on next
application.solution: A. next。表示将来的“下周日”用 next Sunday，前面不加介词。

examTags: 语言运用·动词与介词宾语
grammar: him 是人称代词 he 的宾格，指男性；常放在动词或介词后作宾语。
collocations: help him; talk to him; sit next to him; give him a photo
commonMistake: 主语位置用 he，动词或介词后作宾语用 him；不要说 I sit next to he。

example.english: I often talk to him about our family.
example.chinese: 我常和他谈论我们的家庭。

application.prompt: 选词填空：My cousin is kind, and I often play football with ___. A. him  B. he
application.solution: A. him。介词 with 后用宾格 him。

grammar: help 可作动词“帮助”或名词“帮助”。动词常用 help sb (to) do sth、help sb with sth；名词 help 通常不可数。
collocations: help my parents; help sb (to) do sth; help with housework; ask for help
commonMistake: help sb 后接动词原形或 to do 均可，不接 doing；表示“帮助某人做某事”也可说 help sb with sth。

example.english: I help my parents set the table before dinner.
example.chinese: 晚饭前我帮父母摆餐具。

application.prompt: 选词填空：My sister helps me ___ my homework after dinner. A. with  B. at
application.solution: A. with。help sb with sth 表示“在某方面帮助某人”。
